entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Black-aligned human warlock from Dominaria, main antagonist of the Mirage block; later on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who removed his island from the time stream and sank Kaervek's fleet.

entities.name: Mangara of the White Woods
entities.description: Ruler of Zhalfir trapped by Kaervek in an amber prison, later freed.

entities.name: Jolrael of Mwonvuli
entities.description: Ally of Kaervek who later ambushed him.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: Prison in Aku that held Mangara and later Kaervek.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Kingdom phased out of Dominaria, later a plane in its own right.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Planeswalker whose interference lost Zhalfir in the time streams.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Recruited Kaervek for a vault heist.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Vault at the center of Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: Gang member with enmity toward Kaervek.

events.summary: Kaervek sails to the Chaza Isles to investigate an energy surge and meets Mangara and Jolrael.
events.quote: He did meet with two other people who had been attracted by the energy surge

events.summary: Kaervek allies with Jolrael, persuades her that Mangara means to conquer the continent, and starts a war; he traps Mangara in an Amber Prison.
events.quote: Kaervek managed to trap Mangara in an Amber Prison

events.summary: Kaervek wages a long war with his allies, then attacks Teferi's isle; Jolrael ambushes him and Teferi sinks his fleet.
events.quote: After Teferi sank his fleet, Kaervek managed to escape to the Uuserk Marshes.

events.summary: Mangara is freed, defeats Kaervek and locks him in the amber prison.
events.quote: Mangara then defeated Kaervek and locked him inside the amber prison himself

events.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria, with Kaervek's prison; years later the prison is shattered and Kaervek escapes.
events.quote: Kaervek's prison had been shattered, allowing him to escape

events.summary: Kaervek leaves Zhalfir through an Omenpath after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Kaervek used one to leave the plane

events.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
events.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

events.summary: Kaervek analyzes the vault key and warns that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia.
events.quote: cautioned that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia

events.summary: At Tarnation, Kaervek disables the wards on the vault; it opens and benefactor Jace takes an infant creature and vanishes with Vraska as the vault collapses.
events.quote: the heist's benefactor revealed himself to be Jace Beleren

events.summary: Insulted that Oko cannot pay, Kaervek warns him of dire consequences if Jace and Vraska are not found.
events.quote: Kaervek was insulted and warned Oko

relations.note: Trapped him in an amber prison
relations.quote: Kaervek managed to trap Mangara in an Amber Prison
Kaervek quickly allied himself with Jolrael
his right hand, the panther warrior Purraj
led to enmity between the two of them
was recruited by Oko to take part in a heist
